verdict.rationale: Community users report using Notion to track tasks and projects and as a project or issue tracker, positioned between strict PM tools and wikis. First-party docs confirm creating pages and databases, including via the API and MCP. However, no evidence shows assigning tasks to teammates or setting due dates. missing for 10: documented task assignment to teammates, documented due-date fields or reminders, first-party task-management docs, hands-on corroboration of assignee and due-date workflows.
